in_sanskrit.name: Loving
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Full of Love
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Loving एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prema', meaning love. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the divine goddesses of love and compassion, such as Kamadevi and Lakshmi.
